title: My game have bad early retention: could you play it and tell me what is wrong?
author: Bojack92160
selftext:
It is a free mobile game, and currently the early retention is not good. I would love if someone told me what is the problem in the first 10min of gameplay:

IOS: [https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/z-road-zombie-survival/id6584530506](https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/z-road-zombie-survival/id6584530506)   
ANDROID: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SkyJackInteractive.ZRoad](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SkyJackInteractive.ZRoad)

comments.author: DojkaDev
comments.body: creating a base slows down the action, I wouldn't include base building.

replies.author: Xay_DE
replies.body: yeah, thats the issue, not the fact its full on ai game slop without any originality or love...

replies.author: mushymyco
replies.body: laughed really hard at this one

replies.author: Bojack92160
replies.body: Ah? I included this because I though it bring a nice progression visual, and keep it very simple / quick to not bring too much complexity on this side => Would removing the upgrade building step really speed up the pacing of the game between levels?

replies.author: DojkaDev
replies.body: It's a game to play for a few minutes a day when you're bored, don't expect anything more from it. So the best thing is to always have action and gunfire.

replies.author: Katwazere
replies.body: So many games ruin a quite fun start by forcing you to spend hours on a grind slow development money sink base when all you really want to do is play the game they showed in the trailer

comments.author: xxxC0Y0T3xxx
comments.body: Concept is certainly fun. Played until my fuel ran out and from there I lost interest. It didn’t feel too challenging early on. If you keep the fuel mechanic I’d suggest an endless mode that provides no rewards to play when you’re bored

replies.author: Bojack92160
replies.body: Oh you certainly played a lot to use all the fuel \^\^' => what level did you reached? You didn't die once?

replies.author: xxxC0Y0T3xxx
replies.body: I believe I made it to level 5 of the driving phase. That last one was close however, i was stopped by 2 of the brutes (the giant enemies) and was certain i was done for. But they hardly damaged the car and I still cleared it with half the health I started with.

replies.author: Bojack92160
replies.body: ah yes I see, I reduced the enemies damages for early onboarding but it might remove the challenge

comments.author: Stunning_Macaron6133
comments.body: Well yeah, your game looks like a Twitter ad. Probably plays like one too.

comments.author: rasta500
comments.body: It looks like 5000 other identical games just not as good.

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: I won't play but I think the name sounds funny, I get is like z road, but I just read it as zorad lol

comments.author: irateas
comments.body: I like the base, and upgrades. What I found annoying is that the updates I suppose to hit for some reason seemed like transparent. Been firing up at them and hits were going through. Also - positioning was too wide I think. Often off the screen. To me that was off putting and annoying.

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: This post is not specific to AI based game development. See rule #1.
